proposal.reason: Primary change is in network: NET send-credit head storage defaults to sender-local device memory, with new send-connect payload/mapping lifecycle, initialization, and cleanup in src/transport/net.cc. Add transport because src/transport/p2p.cc introduces an allocation-only proxy-buffer path and ownership/teardown flow used to provision those NET heads via P2P proxy connections. Add memory because src/include/alloc.h adds MEM_LEGACY runtime device allocation/free behavior (and tracking path) that changes allocation semantics used by the new transport/network flow.
